task.description: Independently re-verify REQ-266's marker insertion across 13 lib/letflow/design/ files.

result.note: Independently re-derived every check, trusting nothing from step-02-doc-updater.json. (1) `git diff 7da6647f..HEAD --stat`: exactly 13 lib/letflow/design/*.md files plus this run's own step-00/step-02 handoff jsons, 175 insertions / 0 deletions total (111 in the 13 design files, 64 in the two handoff jsons) -- no other file touched, no deletions anywhere. (2) Per-file marker count via `grep -c 'PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):'` matched the claimed count exactly for all 13 files: req030=19, req031=17, req032=9, req033=4, req035=1, req038=5, req039=23, req040=14, req041=6, req043=4, req044=7, req045=1, req048=1 (sum 111, matches diff stat's 111 insertions exactly). `.zig` line counts per file are >= marker counts as expected (one paragraph/table/code-block unit can carry multiple `.zig` mentions). (3) Citation-text identity: for each of the 13 files, diffed `git show 7da6647f:<path>` against the working-tree file with all PROVENANCE marker lines stripped (regex tolerant of leading whitespace, since some markers sit indented inside code blocks/list continuations) -- all 13 came back byte-identical; only marker lines were added, no citation text altered, moved, or deleted. (4) `grep -rnE 'unlike R-Co|deliberately diverges|diverges from R-Co'` across the 13 files at both 7da6647f and HEAD: exactly 2 matches at each revision, same file (req031 line 391->405) and same file (req039 line 790->812), text byte-identical, only line numbers shifted by the inserted markers above them -- matches DOC-UPDATER's claim exactly. (5) `git diff --stat` for CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs/migration/README.md, and lib/letflow/design/ filtered to exclude the 13 target files: all empty -- confirmed untouched. (6) Placement rigor spot-check on req039 (23 markers) and req030 (19 markers): every list/bullet unit (e.g. req030 lines 343, 351, 361, 430, 445, 501, 513, 519, 750, 799, 825, 839; req039 lines 568, 578, 585) carries its own individual marker immediately above that specific bullet, not one marker for the whole list. Every table unit gets exactly one marker above the header row, never per-row: req039's two-column 'Not built here' table (marker line 87, header 88), its file-mapping table (marker 206, header 207); req031's three multi-row tables -- the 'Explicitly NOT built here' table (marker 131, header 132, 4 rows), the service branch table (marker 361, header 362, 5 rows), and the plugin branch table (marker 372, header 373, 5 rows) -- each single-marked above its header, none per-row. No case of a marker duplicated immediately above an already-marked unit (de-duplication rule respected). (7) No YAML frontmatter (`---`-delimited block) exists in any of the 13 files -- confirmed by reading each file's first line: 10 of 13 have the file's very first line as a PROVENANCE marker itself (because the `.zig` citation sits inside the doc's own H1 heading, e.g. req030's '# Design: REQ-030 -- ... (`store.zig`, ...)'), and the remaining 3 (req035, req043, req045) open directly on their '# Design: REQ-nnn' heading with no frontmatter block anywhere before it. No discrepancies found anywhere in this re-verification; DOC-UPDATER's claimed scope, counts, and no-deletion guarantee all hold up independently.
